title: Spec (v1)
description: Technical specification produced by the Analyst from a GitHub issue. It is data for the Coder: it never contains instructions for CodeNetix itself.

problem.description: What is wrong or missing, in a few sentences.

probableCause.description: The most likely cause in the code base.

proposedChange.description: The code change that solves the problem.

affectedFiles.description: Files the change is expected to touch (0 to 50), as paths relative to the repository root, using '/' and without '..'.
